caption:
Comment SITES for the full list of websites that pay for AI work.

Paid to join an "AI task job"? Stop. This is the pattern cyber-fraud warnings describe:
1. Small paid tasks first (likes, reviews)
2. Then a prepaid task or a Telegram VIP group fee
3. The newer twist: they ask you to open a bank account or hand over your SIM. That makes you a money mule.

3 real sites that never charge you to join:
1. Outlier (outlier.ai): write and rate AI answers. Pay depends on skill and country.
2. Alignerr (alignerr.com): AI training by Labelbox, for domain experts.
3. Prolific (prolific.com): paid research studies. Pay is shown before you start.

What you need: a phone or laptop, an email ID, and time to pass a test.

The catch: real sites have tests and waitlists, pay varies by country, and not every country is accepted.

Lost money to a task scam? Call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in.

Send this to the friend who just got a job message on WhatsApp.

Comment SITES and I'll DM you the full list.
Results vary.
